# feedbackv1

```go
import feedbackv1 "pocketone.dev/ext/contracts/mail/feedback/v1"
```

Package feedbackv1 is the mail.feedback/v1 contract: what mail providers report back about mail an app sent (bounces, complaints, unsubscribes), received at one place and turned into \[Event]s that any extension can act on. The provider receives the reports (Amazon SES through SNS, or a generic webhook); handlers bind [OnEvent](#onevent): a suppression list adds the address, a CRM marks the contact.

A wire contract at /api/\_c/mail.feedback/v1. Its operations are public: SES messages are checked by their SNS signature, webhook calls by a shared secret.

Source: [`ext/contracts/mail/feedback/v1`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/tree/main/ext/contracts/mail/feedback/v1).

<a id="w"></a>

```go
var W = extkit.NewWire(Contract, "public", func(inner Receiver, g *extkit.Guard[Receiver]) Receiver {
	return &guardReceiver{inner, g}
},
	extkit.Op[Receiver]{
		Name:   "s_e_s",
		Desc:   "Takes an Amazon SNS delivery carrying SES bounce and complaint notifications (and confirms the topic subscription). Point an SNS HTTPS subscription here.",
		Method: "POST",
		Path:   "ses",
		Scope:  "public",
		RawIn:  true,
		Out:    extkit.OutJSON,
		Invoke: func(ctx context.Context, impl Receiver, a extkit.Auth, req extkit.OpRequest) (any, error) {
			in := extkit.RawIn{Query: req.Query, Body: req.Body, ContentType: req.ContentType, Header: req.Header}
			return impl.SES(ctx, a, in)
		},
	},
	extkit.Op[Receiver]{
		Name:   "webhook",
		Desc:   "Takes {\"type\": \"bounce|complaint|unsubscribe\", \"email\": ..., \"campaign\": ...} from any provider, with the shared secret in the X-Feedback-Secret header.",
		Method: "POST",
		Path:   "webhook",
		Scope:  "public",
		RawIn:  true,
		Out:    extkit.OutJSON,
		Invoke: func(ctx context.Context, impl Receiver, a extkit.Auth, req extkit.OpRequest) (any, error) {
			in := extkit.RawIn{Query: req.Query, Body: req.Body, ContentType: req.ContentType, Header: req.Header}
			return impl.Webhook(ctx, a, in)
		},
	},
)
```

W is mail.feedback/v1's wire side: routes at /api/\_c/mail.feedback/v1/\<op>, action hooks, MCP tools and the client.

## Functions

### OnEvent

```go
func OnEvent(app core.App) *hook.Hook[*Event]
```

OnEvent is the hook every feedback event goes through, for any number of handlers.

### OnSES

```go
func OnSES(owner any, fn func(e *extkit.CallEvent, in *extkit.RawIn) error)
```

OnSES binds fn to s\_e\_s calls on owner (an app, or a host's scope for calls the host answers). Call e.Next() to continue; return an error to refuse. in is the call's input; changes reach the provider.

### OnWebhook

```go
func OnWebhook(owner any, fn func(e *extkit.CallEvent, in *extkit.RawIn) error)
```

OnWebhook binds fn to webhook calls on owner (an app, or a host's scope for calls the host answers). Call e.Next() to continue; return an error to refuse. in is the call's input; changes reach the provider.

### Raise

```go
func Raise(app core.App, ev *Event) error
```

Raise sends ev through [OnEvent](#onevent) (providers call it for each report).

### Client

```go
type Client struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Client is mail.feedback/v1 over HTTP, for the CLI and other apps. It implements Receiver; the token it was made with is the credential, so the extkit.Auth argument is ignored.

### NewClient

```go
func NewClient(baseURL, token string, hc *http.Client) *Client
```

NewClient calls mail.feedback/v1 on the app at baseURL with token (a PocketBase auth token or an API token).

### Event

```go
type Event struct {
	hook.Event
	App      core.App
	Kind     string // Bounce, Complaint or Unsubscribe
	Email    string
	Campaign string // the bulk mail campaign it was about, when known (X-Bulkmail-Campaign)
	Source   string // ses, webhook, ...
}
```

Event is one report about one address.

### Receiver

```go
type Receiver interface {
	// SES takes an Amazon SNS delivery carrying SES bounce and complaint notifications (and confirms the topic
	// subscription). Point an SNS HTTPS subscription here.
	//
	//op: POST ses scope=public
	SES(ctx context.Context, a extkit.Auth, in extkit.RawIn) (Ack, error)

	// Webhook takes {"type": "bounce|complaint|unsubscribe", "email": ..., "campaign": ...} from any provider, with
	// the shared secret in the X-Feedback-Secret header.
	//
	//op: POST webhook scope=public
	Webhook(ctx context.Context, a extkit.Auth, in extkit.RawIn) (Ack, error)
}
```

Receiver takes mail providers' reports.
